title: DPIIT Recognition Certificate
why_template: Verifies Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade startup status for Section 56(2)(viib) angel tax exemptions and public procurement benefits in India.

title: Fully Diluted Cap Table & ESOP Pool Documentation
why_template: Validates exact founder equity ownership, investor share classes, option grants, and unallocated ESOP reserves prior to investment.

title: Shareholder Agreements (SHA) & Articles of Association (AoA)
why_template: Confirms governance rights, liquidation preferences, tag-along/drag-along clauses, and statutory charter alignment with existing institutional investors.

title: Certificate of Incorporation & MCA Filings (Form MGT-7/AOC-4)
why_template: Validates statutory compliance with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, timely annual filing history, and authorized share capital standing.

title: Monthly GST Returns (GSTR-1 & GSTR-3B for Past 12 Months)
why_template: Cross-verifies reported top-line revenue against statutory indirect tax return filings with the Indian GST portal.

title: Audited Financial Statements & CA-Certified MIS
why_template: Provides independent auditor assurance of revenue recognition, operating expenses, asset depreciation, and historical net burn.

title: Primary Bank Account Statements (Past 12 Months)
why_template: Verifies true cash-in-bank liquidity, monthly operating burn rate, customer collections, and absence of undisclosed overdrafts.

title: Founder & Employee IP Assignment Agreements
why_template: Guarantees that all proprietary software code, algorithms, and technical assets are unequivocally owned by the company rather than individual developers.

title: Trademark & Patent Application Filings
why_template: Protects brand equity and proprietary technology from infringement under the Indian Trade Marks Registry and Patent Office.

title: DPDP Act 2023 Compliance & Consent Architecture
why_template: Ensures processing of personal data, digital consent collection, and user grievance redressal conform to the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023.

title: Customer Master Service Agreements (MSAs) & Signed LOIs
why_template: Substantiates stated pilot commercial terms, contract values (ACV/TCV), termination covenants, and revenue retention commitments.

title: Cohort Retention & Blended CAC-by-Channel Breakdown
why_template: Validates customer payback periods, organic vs paid acquisition efficiency, and net revenue retention across monthly cohorts.

title: Granular Unit-Economics & Sensitivity Model
why_template: Audits gross margin durability, contribution margin per transaction, and break-even dependency on scale and marketing efficiency.

title: Product Technical Architecture & System Design Document
why_template: Validates scalability, latency guarantees, fault-tolerance mechanisms, and third-party infrastructure dependencies for production workloads.

title: Third-Party API Commercial Agreements & Software Licenses
why_template: Audits vendor dependency risks, rate limits, enterprise pricing schedules, and open-source license compliance (e.g., GPL contamination).

title: Data Sourcing Proof & Training Data Licensing Rights
why_template: Confirms training sets, web data, and proprietary corpora were acquired lawfully without scraping violations or copyright infringement.

title: Independent Security Audit & VAPT Certification
why_template: Demonstrates enterprise-grade cybersecurity posture and vulnerability remediation by a CERT-In empanelled auditor.

title: Employment Agreements & Statutory Labor Compliance (PF, ESI, Gratuity)
why_template: Guarantees key personnel retention covenants, non-compete enforceability, and statutory remittances to EPFO and ESIC in India.

title: Litigation & Statutory Notice Declaration
why_template: Discloses any past, pending, or threatened litigation, arbitrations, tax assessment notices, or regulatory inquiries.

title: FEMA & RBI FDI Compliance Records (FC-GPR / FCGPR Filings)
why_template: Mandatory for startups receiving cross-border foreign direct investment to demonstrate timely RBI approval and compliance with FDI sectoral caps.
